title: Party Mashup
description:
Party Mashup is a goofy local party game with 11 fast minigames, bot support, Quick Play, tournament mode, and Steam Remote Play Together.

Jump straight into a random minigame, play solo with bots, compete on the couch with friends, or use Steam Remote Play Together to bring the chaos to people who are not in the room. Each minigame is quick to learn, easy to laugh at, and built for the kind of messy competition where one round turns into “one more.”

Quick Party ChaosChase chickens, dodge attacks, fight for points, launch eggs, score goals, and try to survive whatever your friends and the bots are doing around you. The rules change from game to game, but the goal is always simple: win the round and make everyone else regret their choices.

Jump In With Quick PlayWant to skip setup? Quick Play drops you straight into a random minigame with open slots filled by bots, so you can start playing fast even when you are the only person ready to party.

Play Solo, Couch, Or Remote Play TogetherParty Mashup supports bots, so solo players can still compete across the minigames. Add friends locally for couch multiplayer, or invite them through Steam Remote Play Together.

Tournament ModeTake on a one-player tournament against bots, fight through cycle of minigames, and submit your best runs to the online leaderboards. It is a quick way to chase a better score even when you are playing solo.

11 Minigames• ChickenChaser

• Featherweight Fight

• Rooster Rumble

• Eggmancers

• Exploding Chickens

• Disco Coop

• Egg Express

• Cluck Burger Rush

• Chicken Kickoff

• King Chicken

• Yolk & Load

Features

• 11 chaotic party minigames

• Quick Play for instant random minigames

• Solo play with bots

• Local multiplayer for couch competition

• One-player Tournament Mode with online leaderboards

• Steam Remote Play Together support

• Fast rounds built for rematches, laughs, and streamable moments

• Bright low-poly arenas, simple controls, and goofy chicken chaos

Built For Fast, Ridiculous CompetitionParty Mashup is made for quick sessions with friends, family, classmates, or anyone who enjoys a little friendly nonsense. Pick a mode, fill the match, and let the party fall apart in the best way.
description_short: Jump into Quick Play, chase chickens, battle bots or friends, and compete across 11 goofy minigames with solo tournaments, online leaderboards, local play, and Steam Remote Play Together.
